baseline: Saved fixed SN1_H1 historical-valid scores from DM-20260927-04; no refit or score changes
confirmation_policy: One hindsight descriptive run under explicit current-graph stability assumption. Current 2026.09 graph is held constant across 2025; results are not PIT, independent OOS, candidate selection, or strategy adoption. One locked edge filter and NCMOM20 horizon; no rescue variants.

trials.comparison: NCMOM20 and saved SN1_H1 rankings on identical network-covered issuer-days; NCMOM RankIC/Q5-Q1 within daily SN1 quintiles; matched-subset Q5-long/Q1-short diagnostics. No blended candidate.

feature_definitions.graph_snapshot: JP_Market_Vis M5_company_relations / M4_companies version 2026.09, generated 2026-09-22, held unchanged over 2025
feature_definitions.relation: Directed supplier -> customer major_customer only; confirmed status and at least one primary EDINET evidence; unique listed endpoint mapping; de-duplicate supplier/customer pairs
feature_definitions.ncmom20: Equal mean across mapped customers of 20 finite preceding market-session sums of raw_return - beta * TOPIX; window ends at t-1; no signal-day/future return; missing if no customer has a complete window
feature_definitions.target: Official target_1day_valid Return on same Date/Code index for descriptive historic-valid analysis; raw_target prohibited
feature_definitions.missing: No zero fill; missing customer histories excluded and customer/edge coverage reported
feature_definitions.crosswalk: M4 securities_code to per-date listed_info_valid Code with unique exact documented relation and consistent company-name match only; no fuzzy match

model: None; no model fit or SN1 score blend

parameters.portfolio_construction: Daily equal-weight top-quintile long / bottom-quintile short on same network-covered names for each signal; first date invested from cash
parameters.turnover: sum(abs(daily target weights - prior target weights)), initialized from cash

selection_rule: No adoption or pass/reject decision. Report fixed descriptive results and coverage; 2025 historic Valid plus postdated graph prevent PIT/OOS claims.
